## 1. Company & Product

**Company:** Hansaria Food Private Limited (Kolkata, West Bengal, India)
- Founded: 2018-06-15. Founders: Gopal Agarwal, Sunita Agarwalla.
- Domain: Agri-commodity supply & brokerage — maize (corn), soya DOC, M DOC, DDGS,
  poultry/animal feed raw materials.
- Site name / app: "Hansaria Food". Theme color teal (`#0F766E`). Locale `en-IN`,
  timezone `Asia/Kolkata`.
- Contact: +91-98304-33535 · info@hansariafood.com
- Developer (SEO credit): Santu De, Full Stack Developer.

**Product:** An internal rate-entry & sauda (deal) management web app + PWA.
Employees log in (mobile OTP) and enter daily rates, create/update sauda deals
against buyer companies, manage sellers/companies/locations/commodities/categories,
run analytics, and send rate/sauda reports via WhatsApp (Hansaria/hfconnect API),
email, and in-app notifications (Socket.io).

**Key business terms (glossary):**
| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Rate | Daily price (₹) of a commodity for a company × location. |
| Sauda | A trade deal: buyer company, seller, company, commodity, tons, rate, delivery date. |
| Commodity | Maize, Soya DOC, M DOC, DDGS, etc. |
| Category | Grouping for companies (e.g. buyer type). |
| Location | Origin/buyer unit (e.g. plant/branch). |
| Loading From | Indian state of origin (from `src/data/state-city.json`). |
| Buyer Company | The purchasing company (buyer type). |
| Seller | Selling party; each seller has a list of companies. |
| ManageCompany | Canonical company record with locations, commodities, visibility flags. |
| Rate Taken | Per-day tracker of buyer companies whose rates have been taken. |

---

## 2. Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19. Interactive components use `"use client"`.
- **Language:** JavaScript (`.jsx` / `.js`). **No TypeScript.** Do not introduce `.ts` files.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 via `@tailwindcss/postcss`. `src/app/globals.css`
  does `@import "tailwindcss";`. Dark mode via the `dark:` variant (class strategy).
- **Icons:** `lucide-react` only — do not add another icon library.
- **Animations:** `framer-motion` (Welcome screen, cards, modals).
- **State:** React hooks + Context (`UserContext`, `SocketContext`). Feature logic in `src/hooks/**`.
- **HTTP:** `axiosInstance` (`@/lib/axiosInstance/axiosInstance`) — base `/api`,
  `x-api-key` header (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY`), auto-retry on 5xx for GET/HEAD,
  GET request de-duplication, longer timeouts for rate/analytics/export paths.
  **Always use this, never raw axios/fetch.**
- **Toasts:** `react-toastify` (`toast.success/error/warn`).
- **Realtime:** Socket.io via custom `server.mjs` (same port as Next).
- **Backend:** Next.js Route Handlers `src/app/api/**`. Mongoose models `src/models/**`.
  MongoDB connection `src/lib/mongodb.js`.
- **Auth:** NextAuth.js (mobile OTP). `withAuth` middleware; admins from
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_MOBILES`.
- **Messaging:** Hansaria/hfconnect API (WhatsApp-style), Nodemailer (email).
- **Exports:** `exceljs`, `jspdf`/`html2canvas`/`jspdf-autotable`, `xlsx`.
- **Scheduling:** `node-cron` in `server.mjs` (daily rate & sauda reports at 8 PM IST).

---

## 3. Getting Started

### Commands
```bash
npm install        # install deps
npm run dev        # dev server + sockets (server.mjs), port 16000 by default
npm run build      # production build
npm start          # production (server.mjs)
npm run lint       # NOTE: eslint config is currently broken (see §10)
```
Dev server: `http://localhost:16000` (set `PORT` to override).

### Environment variables (`.env.local`)
```env
# DB & auth
MONGODB_URI=
NEXTAUTH_URL=
NEXTAUTH_SECRET=

# Client-facing
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY=
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=
NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_MOBILES=98XXXXXXXX,99XXXXXXXX   # comma-separated admin mobiles

# Messaging (Hansaria / hfconnect)
HANSARIA_API_BASE_URL=https://hfconnect.in
HANSARIA_API_URL=https://hfconnect.in/api/v1/messages/send
HANSARIA_API_KEY=
HANSARIA_ADMIN_ID=
HANSARIA_TEMPLATE_NAME=hansaria_new_bid
HANSARIA_RATE_TEMPLATE_ID=...
HANSARIA_SAUDA_TEMPLATE_ID=...
HANSARIA_OTP_TEMPLATE_ID=...
```
Never expose server secrets in client code. Keep API keys out of git.

## 4. Project Structure

```
rateentry/
├── server.mjs                 # custom Next server + Socket.io + cron
├── public/                    # static assets, icons, manifest, sw.js (PWA)
└── src/
    ├── app/
    │   ├── layout.js          # RootLayout: fonts, providers, Header/Footer, Toast
    │   ├── globals.css        # Tailwind import + CSS vars
    │   ├── <route>/page.jsx   # pages (rate, sauda, company, managecompany, ...)
    │   └── api/<...>/route.js # backend route handlers
    ├── components/
    │   ├── common/            # shared: Dropdown, Modal, Loading, Title, Header, Footer...
    │   └── ui/                # feature components (Sauda, Rate, Welcome, ...)
    ├── hooks/                 # feature hooks (one folder per feature)
    ├── lib/                   # axiosInstance, mongodb, auth, socket, email, reports, seo
    ├── models/                # Mongoose schemas (Company, ManageCompany, Rate, SaudaEntry, Seller, ...)
    ├── middleware/middleware.js
    ├── config/navigation.js   # nav + admin mobiles
    ├── context/               # UserContext, SocketContext
    ├── data/                  # state-city.json, holiday.json, cookiePolicy.json
    └── utils/                 # export/excel/pdf helpers, formatting, motion variants
```
Path alias: `@/` → `src/` (`jsconfig.json`).

---

## 5. Domain / Data Models

Source of truth: `src/models/**`. Key entities:

| Model | File | Purpose | Key fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Company** | `Company.js` | Simple company (name, category, type buyer/seller) | `name`, `category`, `type[]`, `isSelfCompany` |
| **ManageCompany** | `ManageCompany.js` | Canonical company with contacts/locations | `name`, `location[]`, `state`, `category`, `commodities[]`, `mobileNumbers[]`, `isSoyaVisible`, `isDDGSVisible`, `isMDOCVisible` |
| **Rate** | `Rate.js` | Daily rate per company×location×commodity | `company`, `location`, `commodity`, `newRate`, `newRateDate`, `quantity`, `payment`, `others`, `oldRates[]` |
| **SaudaEntry** | `SaudaEntry.js` | Day's sauda deals per company | `company`, `date`, `saudaEntries` (Map of `unit-commodity` → array of `{tons, finalRate, unit, commodity, sellerName, sellerCompany, deliveryDate, loadingFrom, saudaNo, others}`). `getNextSaudaNumber(date)` returns `FY-####` (FY starts April). |
| **Seller** | `Seller.js` | Sellers and their companies | `sellerName`, `companies[]` |
| **Category** | `Category.js` | Categories for companies | `name` |
| **RateTaken** | `RateTaken.js` | Per-day "rates taken" tracker | `date`, `companyIds[]` (resets on India date change) |
| **User** | `User.js` | App users (mobile-based) | mobile, name, hfconnect id, etc. |
| **UserCompany** | `UserCompany.js` | Company assignments per user | mobile → companies |
| Other | `Commodity.js`, `Location.js`, `Freight.js`, `Task.js`, `DeletedSauda.js`, `TagSauda.js`, `SaudaStatus.js`, `RateHistory.js`, `RateUpdate.js`, `Purchase.js`, `EmployeeStatus.js`, `DescriptionStats.js` |

**Date format for records:** `YYYY-MM-DD` (India date). UI display uses `en-IN`.

---

## 6. Authentication & Middleware

- NextAuth credentials (mobile OTP). Sign-in page `/`.
- `src/middleware/middleware.js`: `withAuth` protects all routes except public ones
  (login, forgot/reset password, policy pages, `/api`, static assets). Unauthenticated
  → redirect to `/` with `callbackUrl`.
- Admins = `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_MOBILES` (comma-separated). Determines admin dashboard
  view (Welcome.jsx) and extra privileges.
- API keys: `x-api-key` header checked by `apiKeyMiddleware` on protected routes.
- Single-device guard middleware exists (`singleDeviceGuard`).

---

## 7. API & Data Fetching

- All client calls go through `axiosInstance` → `/api/<route>`.
- Notable endpoints:
  - `GET/POST /api/rate-taken` — daily rate-taken tracker.
  - `GET /api/managecompany?type=buyer&page=&limit=` — buyer companies (paginated, 100/page).
  - `GET /api/categories?limit=` — categories.
  - `POST /api/save-sauda`, `POST /api/save-sauda/delete-entry` — sauda CRUD.
  - `GET /api/rate`, `/api/rate-analysis`, `/api/analytics/*` — rate data & analytics.
  - `/api/auth/*` (NextAuth), `/api/auth/register`, `/api/seller`, `/api/companies`, etc.
- Server-side reports: `src/lib/reports/dailyRateReport.js`, `dailySaudaReport.js`.

---

## 8. UI / UX Conventions

**MUST follow on every new/edited UI element:**

1. **Dark + light mode mandatory.** Every element needs `dark:` variants for bg,
   border, text, hover. Surfaces: `bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-900/70` + `backdrop-blur-xl`.
2. **No native `<select>` for filtering.** Use chip/pill selectors for small/medium
   option sets (e.g. categories). Chips: `rounded-full`, outlined when inactive,
   gradient (`from-indigo-500 to-violet-600`) when active, with a clear/reset link.
3. **Icon + text.** Pair buttons/chips with a small `lucide-react` icon (13–17px).
4. **Glassmorphism cards:** `rounded-2xl`/`rounded-3xl`, `border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10`,
   soft shadow, optional decorative gradient glow blob (absolute, blurred, `pointer-events-none`).
5. **Color semantics:**
   - Pending/to-do: **sky** (`sky-50`, `sky-200`, `sky-700` / dark `sky-500/10`, `sky-300`).
   - Done/taken: **emerald** (`emerald-50`, `emerald-200`, `emerald-700` / dark `emerald-500/10`, `emerald-300`).
   - Accent gradient: **indigo → violet** (`from-indigo-500 to-violet-600`).
   - Progress gradient: **emerald → teal** (`from-emerald-400 to-teal-500`).
   - Danger: red-600 hover red-700.
6. **Inputs:** `h-9`, rounded, `border-slate-300 dark:border-gray-700`, `bg-white dark:bg-gray-800`,
   focus ring colored by intent.
7. **Loading:** inline `Loader2` (animate-spin) inside the button/chip when possible.
8. **Errors:** consistent alert card — red-tinted bg, `AlertCircle` icon, pill Retry button.
9. **Empty states:** dashed-border card with a clear message (not a misleading "all done").
10. **Responsive grids:** 2-col mobile → 4-col md → 6-col lg. Add `min-w-0` to grid children.
11. **Preserve logic on redesigns.** When redesigning, keep state, handlers, API
    calls, and data flow identical — change only markup/classes and visual order.

---

## 9. Component-Specific Rules

### 9.1 RateTakenSection — `src/components/ui/Welcome/RateTakenSection.jsx`
- Category filter = chip row (`All` + categories), active = indigo→violet gradient.
  Long lists scroll in a `max-h-28` area using `scrollbar-hidden`.
- "Daily progress" card: count, percentage badge, animated progress bar (filtered set).
- Pending = sky chips with `+`; taken = emerald chips with `CheckCircle2` + `RotateCcw`.
  Inline `Loader2` spinner while a save is in flight.

### 9.2 SaudaTable entry form — `src/components/ui/Sauda/SaudaTable/SaudaTable.jsx`
Each sauda entry card uses a **6-col grid on `lg`** in 4 rows:
1. `Rate` · `Tons` · `Loading From` (2 cols each)
2. `Seller` · `Company` (3 cols each — dropdowns get more room)
3. `Sauda No` · `Delivery Date` · Save/Remove buttons (2 cols each; buttons right-aligned)
4. `Others` / `+ notes` (full width)

Breakpoints: 2-col mobile, 4-col md. Filled entry = green border/card; incomplete = red.
Buttons: `rounded-lg` + shadow, baseline-aligned.

---

## 10. Scripts & Tooling

- `package.json` scripts: `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`.
- **ESLint is currently broken.** `eslint.config.mjs` throws
  `TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON` from `@eslint/eslintrc`.
  Do not run `npx eslint`. Use IDE diagnostics (`GetDiagnostics`) instead.
  Do not modify the config unless the task is to fix it.
- Tailwind v4 linter suggests `bg-linear-to-*` instead of `bg-gradient-to-*` —
  **ignore**; the codebase uses `bg-gradient-to-*` and we keep that convention.
- PowerShell note: `&&`/`||` not supported in PowerShell 5; use `;` or separate commands.

---

## 11. Working Rules for Agents

1. Always `Read` the target file before editing. Keep edits scoped to the request.
2. Do **not** add new dependencies without asking.
3. Do **not** introduce TypeScript.
4. Do **not** add a new icon library — use `lucide-react`.
5. Use `axiosInstance` for all API calls.
6. After edits, run `GetDiagnostics` and address real errors (ignore the `bg-gradient` suggestion).
7. Never expose secrets in client code or commit them.
8. Keep this file in sync when conventions change.
